items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And Austin Crawford and I were there with you? Yeah, that's right. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that's right.

ctx.x: Yeah, he wrote some things for that.

Yeah, well, I'll keep my mouth shut. You know what I mean. Uh, about that. Uh, about that. Anyway, uh, I was wondering about the scene back then, in those times, you see, that was 1963, when I used to go to the lamppost. And then I used to go around, remember when you played that advertisement with Chester Jones? On a truck? And Austin Crawford and I were there with you? Yeah, that's right.
